an3.18:1.1: “Bhikkhus, if wanderers of other sects were to ask you thus:
an3.18:1.2: ‘Friends, do you lead the spiritual life under the ascetic Gotama for the sake of rebirth in the deva world?’
an3.18:1.3: wouldn’t you be repelled, humiliated, and disgusted?”
an3.18:1.5: “Thus, bhikkhus, since you are repelled, humiliated, and disgusted with a celestial life span, celestial beauty, celestial happiness, celestial glory, and celestial authority,
an3.18:1.6: so much more then should you be repelled, humiliated, and disgusted with bodily misconduct, verbal misconduct, and mental misconduct.”
